name: Helio-Kemet Sun Realm
summary: Aten Ra forces climb an S-shaped river-of-light campaign road from Sacred Sun Temple to the Mythos Gate boss portal, establishing the campaign-map language for faction chapters. Full mission-arc recreation pass now rewrites all seven Mythos Gates routes with route-native chapter arcs, mission titles, objectives, dialogue hooks, and mission art prompts.
loreDirectorNotes: Frames Aten Ra as solar law under siege by obsidian eclipse corruption. The boss gate silhouette is not a playable hero; it is a campaign apex threat.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Five-node mobile campaign structure with mission progress, star ratings, challenge node, and tactical battle handoff into a tiered Sun Realm gate map. Current pass targets dungeon-route pacing, one-deity readability, shrine/treasure/boss nodes, and faction-specific hazard language.
artDirectorNotes: Uses the Helio-Kemet campaign and battle references as locked layout guides: top-left chapter banner, top-right currency bar, left progress bar, S-path nodes, and peak boss gate.
developmentDirectorNotes: Use this campaign as the template for future faction campaign-map menus and tactical battle transitions.
recommendedNextTask: Tune individual boss mechanics and playable route UI now that every route has rewritten mission arcs.

mobileUe5Architecture.structure: Campaign → Region → Zone → Exploration → Encounter → Tactical Combat → Reward → Next Zone
mobileUe5Architecture.zoneStrategy: large detailed modular zones, not seamless open world and not generic corridors
mobileUe5Architecture.prototypeGate: Do not expand implementation ahead of approved first-zone loop.

oneTitanVsManyCombat.fictionLabel: one selected playable deity against many enemies

mythosGatesCampaignRecreation.combatRule: one selected god or goddess enters each dungeon/combat route; no armies, no squads, no simultaneous party
mythosGatesCampaignRecreation.loreRule: Ascension expands existing divine power during the Gate crisis; it never turns mortals into gods and never reduces Gates to simple portals.
